snippet.description:
ভারত থেকে দেশে ফিরলেই পলাতক প্রধানমন্ত্রী শেখ হাসিনাকে গ্রেফতার করে কারাগারে পাঠানো হবে। বার্তা সংস্থা রয়টার্সকে দেয়া সাক্ষাৎকারে এমনটি জানিয়েছেন পররাষ্ট্র প্রতিমন্ত্রী শামা ওবায়েদ। 

Upon her return to the country from India, fugitive Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will be arrested and sent to prison. State Minister for Foreign Affairs Shama Obaid stated this in an interview with the news agency Reuters.

snippet.title: Hadjar Explaining What TEAMWORK Is to Red Bull 😂
snippet.description:
🏎️ At the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix, Isack Hadjar finds himself battling Max Verstappen for position, but Red Bull has a different priority: avoid losing time and protect the gap to George Russell behind. Despite having a powerful slipstream down the long straights, Hadjar is repeatedly told not to attack his teammate.

📻 As Verstappen defends into Turn 1, Hadjar follows team orders and backs off, but he isn't convinced it's the right strategy. Over team radio, he questions why Max keeps defending and explains the huge speed difference caused by the powerful slipstream in Las Vegas. With Russell lurking behind, Hadjar doesn't want to keep sacrificing time by staying stuck behind Verstappen.

😂 Hadjar then makes his case to Red Bull, explaining why allowing him and Verstappen to overtake and repass each other could actually make the team faster overall. His argument? Hadjar could tow Verstappen around one lap, allowing Max to return the favour with the slipstream on the next.

snippet.title: അസംബ്ലി School Days 🏫 | ഒരിക്കൽ കൂടി ആ വരിയിൽ നിൽക്കാൻ… | Malayalam Animation by muttam stories
snippet.description:
ഒമ്പതേകാലിന് ആ ബെല്ലടിക്കുമ്പോൾ തുടങ്ങുന്ന യുദ്ധം ഓർമ്മയുണ്ടോ? 🔔

ഓടുന്ന വഴിക്ക് ഷർട്ട് ഇൻ ചെയ്യുന്നത്, ഒരു കയ്യിൽ ബെൽറ്റ്, മറ്റേ കയ്യിൽ ഐഡി കാർഡ്, പൊക്കത്തിന്റെ ഓർഡറിൽ വരി, പ്രാർത്ഥനയ്ക്കിടയിലെ ചിരി, ചുണ്ടനക്കാതെയുള്ള രഹസ്യ സംസാരം, ആ നുള്ള്, "ഇന്റർവെല്ലിന് കാണിച്ചുതരാടാ" എന്ന നോട്ടം, HM-ന്റെ "അവസാനമായി ഒരു കാര്യം കൂടി"… പിന്നെ ആ വീഴ്ചകൾ 😂

അന്ന് ആ വെയിലും ആ വരിയും ഒരു ശിക്ഷയായിരുന്നു.
ഇന്ന് ഒരിക്കൽ കൂടി ആ വരിയിൽ പോയി നിൽക്കാൻ എന്ത് കൊടുക്കാനും നമ്മൾ റെഡിയാണ് ❤️

Remember the school assembly? The shirt tucked in on the run, the laugh you couldn't stop, the HM's "one last thing" for the third time, and the kid who "fainted" just to sit in the shade. 😄
Back then it felt like punishment. Today, we'd give anything to stand in that line once more.

👇 നിങ്ങളുടെ സ്കൂൾ അസംബ്ലിയിലെ ഏറ്റവും രസകരമായ ഓർമ്മ കമന്റ് ചെയ്യൂ!
Tag that friend who always pinched you in the line 😜

After returning home from prison, Foogiano found himself caught between his loyalty to Pooh Shiesty and his relationship with the man who helped put him on.

And he wasn’t about to make his decision off what everybody else was saying.

During a recent interview, Foogiano explained that he waited about two weeks before reaching out to Gucci himself.

But here’s where things got interesting.

According to Foogiano, Gucci suggested he’d already chosen a side because of his friendship with Pooh Shiesty.

Foogiano wasn’t going for that.

He made it clear he was a grown man who could make his own decisions.

And before discussing money, contracts, or anything else, he had ONE question.

“Man, did you do it?”

Foogiano was referring to the controversy surrounding allegations that Gucci cooperated with authorities in the Pooh Shiesty case.

He never repeated Gucci’s exact answer, but said the conversation left him unable to continue representing his former label boss’s brand.

And the surprising part?

Foogiano says he was prepared to defend Gucci if he believed the allegations weren’t true.

He just wanted to hear it from the man himself.

snippet.title: Cara indonesia jatohin rudal hipersonik!
snippet.description:
Saking panasnya gesekan udara pas melesat di atas kecepatan Mach 5 di dalam atmosfer, suhu permukaan rudal hipersonik itu bisa terpanggang sampai lebih dari 2.000 derajat Celsius, makanya bodinya harus dilapisi keramik khusus karbon-karbon biar nggak meleleh di jalan!

Awan plasma panas yang nyelimutin bodi rudal ini sebenarnya kayak pedang bermata dua: di satu sisi bikin rudalnya susah dilacak radar musuh, tapi di sisi lain juga bikin antena GPS dan komunikasi di dalam rudal itu sendiri sempat "buta" sesaat (plasma blackout).

Saat ini, badan riset pertahanan Amerika (DARPA) lagi ngembangin pencegat khusus bernama Glide Breaker yang dirancang buat menabrak wahana hipersonik musuh tepat di fase meluncurnya di lapisan stratosfer!

Sumber:

Boyd, I. D. (2015). Computation of atmospheric entry flows about hypersonic vehicles. Progress in Aerospace Sciences, 79, 13-29.

Sayler, K. M. (2023). Hypersonic Weapons: Background and Issues for Congress. Congressional Research Service (CRS) Report R45811.
